Overview

With a platform height of 8 metres, it offers an expansive 259-degree field of view, accommodating up to 13 occupants comfortably and safely. These specifications ensure superior observational capabilities, setting this listing apart from standard options.

Key Specifications

  • Occupancy: 13 people
  • Session Length: 4 hours (per person, confirmed upon acceptance)

Industry-Standard Metrics

All listed figures adhere strictly to the six-axis criteria that define excellence within this category. By benchmarking against these industry-leading parameters, this mast guarantees consistent, high-quality performance and reliability.
